info.title: API.SH: Carwow
info.description: The Carwow API from API.SH: public Carwow data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One car on Carwow: make, model, variant title, state (used, pre-registered), cash price, deal score, new price (RRP), body, fuel, gearbox, year, mileage, power, engine, registration plate, every spec (doors, seats, colour, CO2, emissions standard, insurance group, 0-62, top speed, MPG, boot space), key features, the standard equipment by section, why-this-car highlights, the dealer (name, link, location, top rated, test drive) and all photos. `latest=true` with search parameters returns the newest-registered matching car. 404 for an unknown or sold deal.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/carwow-car

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Deal id (`id` in search, e.g. f72940c7f8291603dcbcf126ec409401) or a carwow.co.uk deal link. Required unless latest=true.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `true`: the newest-registered car of a search with the other parameters (make, model, fuel, ...) instead of an id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.title: 2023 Kia Niro 1.6 GDi Hybrid DCT 3 Used Greater Manchester

items: 2x C-Type Charge Port on Front Seats

get.description:
New-car deals on Carwow (cars in stock at dealers and new cars to order, cash prices and leasing offers), a full page at a time: deal id and link (`offer_type`: stock, to_order for a car built to order linked to the site's configurator, or lease with `lease` terms: contract months, annual miles, upfront months), make and model, variant, cash or monthly price, saving and RRP, deal score and rating, gearbox, fuel, engine size, dealer location with coordinates, badges and photos. Same filters, sort and paging as /carwow/v1/search (make and model, price, body style, fuel, gearbox, features, cash or leasing with deal_type, distance from a postcode). Open one deal with /carwow/v1/car. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/carwow-deals

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: Make slug, e.g. bmw, land-rover, mercedes-benz (values: /carwow/v1/filters?name=make).

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Body styles, comma-separated: suv, hatchback, saloon, estate, coupe, convertible, mpv.

parameters.name: fuel
parameters.description: Fuels, comma-separated: petrol, diesel, hybrid, electric.

parameters.name: colour
parameters.description: Colours, comma-separated, e.g. Black, Blue, Grey.

parameters.name: features
parameters.description: Features the car must all have, comma-separated: cruise-control, parking-sensors, touchscreen, navigation, apple-carplay, android-auto, parking-camera, heated-seats, climate-control, leather-seats, ...

parameters.name: min_engine
parameters.description: Minimum engine size in litres, e.g. 1.5.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: Full UK postcode to search around (with max_distance).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The values one Carwow search filter offers, as the site lists them: makes, models of a make, body styles, fuels, colours, features and so on (value, name and count where shown), or the steps of a range filter (price, mileage, engine size, seats, boot, ...). Use the values with /carwow/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/carwow-filters

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Carwow's expert review of one car model: wowscore out of 10, what's good and what's not so good, the most popular version, the reviewer and their role, last-updated date, the full review text, quotes from the reviewers, the page's questions and answers (price, running costs, size), body type, fuel types, seats, the review video and a link to the model's deals. Pass make and model slugs (as in carwow.co.uk/kia/sportage) or the review link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/carwow-reviews

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Carwow review link instead of make and model, e.g. https://www.carwow.co.uk/kia/sportage.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Used and nearly-new cars for sale on Carwow, a full page of about 32 at a time: deal id and link, make and model, variant, cash price, deal score and rating (great / good / fair deal), year, mileage, gearbox, fuel, engine size, dealer location with coordinates, badges (ad, top rated dealer, used), and photos. Filter by make and model, price, mileage, age, body style, fuel, gearbox, engine size, doors, seats, colour, boot space, 0-62 time, top speed, electric range, safety rating, features, cash or leasing, and distance from a postcode; sort by price, mileage or registration date. Listings marked `sponsored` are the site's ads. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/carwow-search

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
